facts.fact: A minor's passport has 36 pages and is valid for 5 years or until the child turns 18, whichever is earlier
facts.quote: Fresh Passport/Re-issue of Passport for Minors (below 18 years of Age), of 5 years validity or till the minor attains the age of 18 whichever is earlier (36 pages)

facts.fact: Fresh applications for minors aged 8 or below get a 10% rebate on the basic passport fee
facts.quote: For fresh Passport application, a rebate of 10% on basic Passport fee will be applicable for minor applicants (age <= 8 years) and senior citizens (age > 60 years).

facts.fact: Tatkaal adds Rs 2,500, paid on top of the application fee
